scope: read-only source/provenance review and independent assertions over actual remote run JSON artifacts; no native rendering or model training
passed_checks: candidate JSON hash matches frozen H0; original static row IDs are unique, disjoint and in range
each three-group binary domain has eight unique sealed route assignments
all four operations reference the same route hash sequence; none/delete/shift/rotate are registered
task frozen context matches CPU checkpoint receipts for static/dynamic/environment/training_state plus event/gauge/camera/preparation identities
shared context hash independently recomputed from candidate, legal evidence, full frozen context and family
all actual action rows remain unrendered with null loss and constraint status; D gap and C residual remain unavailable
all preview points are finite original-world coordinates and refer to registered candidate rows
simulator candidate adapter reads registered observation mask plus only xyz_world/uv sparse LiDAR arrays; no independent semantic/surface/edit reference values enter candidate selection
real target LiDAR indices trace to original DEVA association reviewed on original frames with annotation-assisted target tracking, not edit outcome selection
historical GT/probe mappings are optional diagnostics and do not filter candidates or eligibility
independent malformed-input reproductions confirmed operation-metric validation and incomplete-route registration bugs were fixed
limitations: This is CPU engineering acceptance, not completion of native E0 rendering/restoration gates or scientific D/C validation.
M0 and hybrid8 are reconstruction configurations of one procedural world; no unseen-world generalization result is available.
Three binary groups give a small action domain, while candidate row populations are large; this is not a row-level exhaustive optimum or verified ownership.
Sim masks/tracks are explicitly registered simulator sensor oracles; real association uses annotations and reviewed DEVA predictions.
f_geom and f_bg remain unknown; f_view is an azimuth-sector proxy and f_motion is a CPU field consistency check. No eligibility threshold was calibrated.
Frozen-evidence pure-function isolation was inspected; the full real adapter was not replayed after deleting its actual reference/student directories.
Native coordinate-diagnostic receipts were read, and preview finiteness/membership were independently checked; native coordinate export/render was not rerun.
